videos.title: Amma Spills All on HipTV Trending: "I Was an Influencer for Don Jazzy!"
videos.headline: Amma Spills All on HipTV Trending: "I Was an Influencer for Don Jazzy!"
videos.description:
You think you know everything about the Nigerian entertainment hustle? Think again. In this explosive new episode of HipTV Trending, Amma sits down with us and drops a massive bombshell about her early days working behind the scenes with one of the biggest names in Afrobeats—Don Jazzy.

Look, breaking into the music and digital industry isn't a walk in the park. People see the glitz, the glamour, and the Apple Music "Up Next" features, but they don't see the strategic moves that happen in the background. Amma gets completely real with us today. She didn't just wake up with an audience; she put in the work. She reveals exactly what it was like working as an influencer for the Mavin Records boss, the lessons she learned about the business of music, and how that strategic foundation shaped her current trajectory.

We dive deep into her personal journey, the reality of navigating the Nigerian digital space, and what it actually takes to command attention and stay relevant when everyone is fighting for the spotlight. Whether you are an aspiring creator, an upcoming artist, or just a massive fan of Afrobeats pop culture, there is a golden lesson for you in this conversation.

What you will learn in this interview:

The untold story of Amma’s influencer days with Don Jazzy.

The transition from behind-the-scenes creator to a front-facing talent.

Strategic moves for surviving and thriving in the Nigerian entertainment industry.

Amma's creative process and what is coming next for her brand.

videos.title: INSIDE ZLATAN & DAVITA’S BIG DAY! 😍💍
videos.headline: INSIDE ZLATAN & DAVITA’S BIG DAY! 😍💍
videos.description:
Nigerian music star Zlatan Ibile has officially tied the knot with his longtime partner, Davita Lamai, in a spectacular traditional wedding ceremony held in Lagos on October 24, 2026.

The celebration, tagged #DTTheUnion, brought together family, friends and several prominent names from Nigeria’s entertainment industry, including Davido, K1 De Ultimate, Enioluwa Adeoluwa, Phyno, Teni, Iyabo Ojo, Reekado Banks, Peruzzi, Broda Shaggi and many others.

Zlatan and Davita, who have been together for several years and share two sons, had announced their wedding date earlier this month in a touching “Save the Date” video 

The couple brought culture, fashion and glamour to the celebration, with their traditional looks drawing plenty of attention. Davita celebrated her Edo heritage in a stunning traditional ensemble, while Zlatan complemented her in an elaborate traditional look.

From the star-studded guest list and breathtaking fashion moments to the love, music and celebration, here’s a closer look at the spectacular wedding of Zlatan and Davita.

Watch the full video!

videos.title: Scotty Olorin: Rappers are my favorites in music | HipTV Trending
videos.headline: Scotty Olorin: Rappers are my favorites in music | HipTV Trending
videos.description:
In this exclusive HipTV Trending interview, the incredibly talented Scotty Olorin sits down to talk about his journey, his creative process, and the artists who fuel his inspiration. Known for his unique sound and dynamic presence, Scotty doesn't hold back as he drops a massive revelation about his musical tastes: "Rappers are my favorites in music."

Dive deep into the mind of Scotty as he breaks down exactly why the storytelling, unmatched lyricism, and raw, unapologetic energy of hip-hop resonate with him so profoundly. He unpacks the influence of rap culture on his own artistry, discusses the current state of the music industry, and reveals the hip-hop heavyweights he has on repeat.

Beyond his love for rap, Scotty also gives us an inside look at his upcoming projects, how he navigates the pressures of the spotlight, and what fans can expect from him next. Whether you're a day-one Scotty Olorin fan or a hip-hop head looking for some genuine industry insight, this is an interview you do not want to miss.
